correctness.rationale: Generator identities give the exact stationary balances and square defect; equality-set analysis leaves only the origin. An explicit polynomial W excludes nontrivial compact invariant sets from |x|<=1, and Wirtinger's inequality plus the exact derivative-energy relation yields the strict period floor.

originality.rationale: The fully inspected 1997 primary study analyzes bifurcations and periodic-orbit expansions but targeted full-text checks did not locate these identities or bounds. Accessible later literature focuses on topology, multistability, hidden attractors, and knot classification. Residual full-text priority risks are stated explicitly.

value.rationale: The result supplies a parameter-independent displacement barrier for every nontrivial compact recurrent state and a rigorous T-only lower bound on all nonconstant periods in a classic chaotic oscillator.
